title: Mission V1.6 closure self-reference remediation and canonical re-registration
description: Resolve the V1.5 Phase 3 Acceptance Closure self-reference discovered in Issue #231 by creating a byte-frozen V1.6 Mission with a two-part closure record: a pre-merge Static Closure Record plus a post-merge immutable Terminal Provider Seal. Preserve V1.5 bytes, register the new exact Mission hash, provide a V1.5-to-V1.6 compatibility proof allowing reuse only of unaffected immutable Tests 1-7 evidence, require HIGH-risk fresh provider gates and exact-artifact Owner sign-off, and keep Phase 3 blocked until the amendment becomes canonical.

why_high: This task changes the frozen Mission specification that governs the final V1 operational acceptance and Production Trusted declaration.
Incorrect closure semantics could permit guessed terminal identifiers, Fake PASS, or a non-canonical Acceptance Record.
Mission/amendment paths are deterministically elevated to HIGH.
why_not_lower: The mutation is governance-authority defining even though it is documentation-only.
Owner Human Gate and Security remain mandatory for a Mission amendment.

acceptance_criteria.description: The canonical V1.5 Mission file remains byte-preserved and its SHA-256 remains exactly 7b29943c936592b63ae76a67359a0cae1b3dd99b2323f1811bc7b2e3d03317a1.
The V1.6 Mission SHA-256 is exactly b01ee3d1f02dc4b80d1780db26d2a5cc8163698fc2f6a5544bc8b707d425380e over exact UTF-8 LF bytes and the Mission does not embed its own hash.
V1.6 changes current-version references and Section 32 closure semantics only; no Acceptance Test, controller, workflow, product runtime, protection, risk, or merge semantics are weakened.
Section 32 defines a pre-merge Static Closure Record plus a post-merge Terminal Provider Seal and prohibits guessed/self-embedded terminal provider identifiers.
The V1.5-to-V1.6 Compatibility Proof marks Tests 1-7 UNAFFECTED, Phase 3 AFFECTED, and binds every reused test result to immutable provider evidence.
REGISTRY.md and AMENDMENTS-REGISTRY.md register V1.6 and preserve V1.4/V1.5 history.
The generated Task Catalog includes MA-MISSION-V1-6-CLOSURE-SELFREF-001 and indexes 45 Task Contracts exactly.
Effective risk is HIGH and no downgrade below HIGH is accepted for the Mission amendment paths.
Exact-head Canonical CI and Phase A pass and deterministic Primary Review is provider-derived from GitHub Actions integration 15368.
Exact-artifact Security PASS and ACTIVE Lock are present before HUMAN_PENDING.
Owner amendment sign-off occurs only in HUMAN_PENDING and binds exact Task ID, Head SHA, Artifact Hash, and verified owner rahemih.
Post-Human TOCTOU and Merge Policy revalidate exact head/base/hash/CI/Review/Security/Lock/Protection/Human with zero blockers.
V1.6 becomes canonical FROZEN only after protected merge and exact-SHA post-merge canonical plus Phase A verification pass.
Phase 3 remains blocked until V1.6 is canonical, then must restart with a fresh residual-state check and final live revalidation.
